lessons.title: Fundamentos del Pasado

items.exampleMeaning: Yesterday I went to the cinema.

items.example: La semana pasada tuve una reunión.
items.exampleMeaning: Last week I had a meeting.
I did the homework last night.

items.example: Estuve en la playa el fin de semana.
items.exampleMeaning: I was at the beach last weekend.

lessons.tip: El pasado en español a menudo utiliza verbos diferentes que en inglés. Presta atención al contexto para elegir el verbo correcto.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Where did you go yesterday?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I went to the park.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: What did you do there?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I had a picnic.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Did you like it?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Yes, it was very nice.

scenario.partnerRole: un amigo que pregunta sobre tus actividades recientes
scenario.brief: Habla sobre lo que hiciste ayer y cómo te sentiste al respecto. Haz preguntas para saber más sobre las experiencias de tu amigo.
scenario.goal: Debes compartir tus actividades pasadas y expresar tus opiniones.

lessons.title: Compartiendo Opiniones
lessons.tip: Al compartir opiniones, usa 'me gustó' para cosas que te gustaron y 'no me gustó' para cosas que no te gustaron. Esto ayuda a expresar tus sentimientos claramente.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Did you like the movie?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I liked it a lot.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: What did you think of the ending?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I found it interesting.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: And the music?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: It was great, I loved it.

scenario.partnerRole: un amigo discutiendo una película o evento reciente
scenario.brief: Discute una película o evento al que ambos asistieron. Comparte lo que te gustó o no te gustó de él.
scenario.goal: Debes expresar tus opiniones sobre la película o el evento.

lessons.title: Gustos y Desagrados en el Pasado

items.exampleMeaning: I liked the concert a lot.

items.example: No me gustó nada el libro.
items.exampleMeaning: I didn't like the book at all.
I enjoyed the trip a lot.

lessons.tip: Usa 'me gustó mucho' para gustos fuertes y 'no me gustó nada' para desagrados fuertes. Esto añade énfasis a tus sentimientos.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: How was the concert?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I liked it a lot, it was incredible.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: And the food?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No me gustó nada, fue mala.
dialogue.meaning: I didn't like it at all, it was bad.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Did you find it boring?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: No, I enjoyed it a lot.

scenario.partnerRole: un amigo discutiendo un concierto o viaje reciente
scenario.brief: Habla sobre un concierto o viaje al que asististe. Comparte tus gustos y desagrados sobre él.
scenario.goal: Debes expresar tus gustos y desagrados sobre el concierto o viaje.

lessons.title: Reflexionando sobre Experiencias

items.example: Lo pasé bien en la fiesta.
items.exampleMeaning: I had a good time at the party.

items.meaning: I would like to do it again
items.exampleMeaning: I would like to do the experience again.
I wouldn't go back to that restaurant.

items.example: Me siento feliz por lo que hice.
items.exampleMeaning: I feel happy about what I did.

lessons.tip: Al reflexionar sobre experiencias, usa frases como 'lo pasé bien' para buenos momentos y 'no lo disfruté' para malas experiencias.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: How was the party?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I had a good time, thank you.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Would you like to do it again?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I would like to do it again.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Would you go back to that place?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: No, I wouldn't go back.

scenario.partnerRole: un amigo preguntando sobre tus experiencias recientes
scenario.brief: Discute tus experiencias recientes y cómo te sentiste al respecto. Pregunta a tu amigo sobre sus experiencias también.
scenario.goal: Debes reflexionar sobre tus experiencias y expresar tus sentimientos.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: What did you do on the weekend?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I went to a concert.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Did you like it?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I loved it, it was incredible.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Did you have a good time?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sí, lo pasé bien, pero no me gustó la comida.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I had a good time, but I didn't like the food.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Would you like to do it again?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sí, me gustaría repetir la experiencia.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I would like to do the experience again.

scenario.brief: Habla sobre lo que hiciste recientemente, compartiendo tus opiniones y sentimientos sobre esas experiencias.
scenario.goal: Debes expresar tus gustos y desagrados sobre tus actividades recientes.
